Schedule My Demand Recovery Review
Five-Part Demand Recovery Plan™

Five working documents. One clear order of attack.

1. Your Demand Collapse Diagnosis

See which of the four failure modes is costing you the most work and why the loss may not appear clearly in your reports.

2. Your Market Demand and Buyer-Signal Snapshot

See how demand is forming in your service area, where buyers appear to be in the decision journey and where your current marketing is failing to connect.

3. Your Fix Sequence Priority Matrix

Know what to fix first, what comes next and which tempting marketing projects should wait.

4. Your Prescription

Get the recommended correction for your primary failure mode, including what to do and what not to do.

5. Your 30-, 90- or 120-Day Recovery Sprint

Receive a week-by-week plan with actions, checkpoints and measurable targets.

You keep the complete plan whether or not you hire Marketing Performance Group to implement it.

Why would we prepare this at no cost?

Marketing Performance Group works with only one company per trade, per market.

Before either of us commits to working together, we need to know three things:

  • Where your demand is actually breaking down.
  • Whether EngageEngine™ can materially improve it.
  • Whether your territory is still available.

The plan gives you a real answer. It also lets us determine whether we should work together.

If you want to implement it yourself, it is yours. If you want us to implement it through EngageEngine™, we can discuss that after you have seen the plan.

Is this for you?

The complimentary plan is designed for established HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping and other home-service companies that:

  • Generate approximately $500,000 to $10 million in annual revenue.
  • Have a proven service and operating history.
  • Want more booked work, not more marketing activity.
  • Are prepared to act when the correct failure point is identified.
  • Operate in a trade and market that remain available.

Because every plan is researched and prepared individually, Marketing Performance Group accepts a limited number of qualified companies each month.
